Before the v40 publish, CEO needs to make two small fixes on the page: take July out of the default ranking, and add a line saying July results for most variants are description only.

The July labels themselves are correct. The default ranking takes each variant's worst month across July, August and September, so variants that got lucky in July rise to the top. It should use August/September only (`dashboard.html:461`); July stays as a column you can sort by with a click. The page also lacks the caveat line: July is a real check only for the 5 TK-010 forms and the 8 P-08 cells, and a variant chosen by its July numbers needs checking on new days after September.

I put both fixes for CEO in the TK-018 log and the ticket stays `waiting`. I don't need to re-check after the fix.
